Internal note — looping in details we can offer to smooth AP: 

- Escrow option: We can provision a time‑bound escrow hold (funds are swept to Redwood at settlement but a flag holds release until PO/acceptance is confirmed). This is low friction on our side and often removes procurement roadblocks. Recommend offering this to Acero as an alternative to netting delays.

- ACH mandate: I’ll prepare a one-time ACH mandate PDF for Ana to sign (we accept scanned signature). That covers authorization for the initial push and reduces chargeback friction.

- Partial/roll-forward: If Acero needs to split payment (card now + wire later), we can accept a partial virtual card settlement and capture the remainder by wire — but this requires LOE on our side. Prefer ACH full if possible.

Next steps I’ll take after Aisha's go: create ACH mandate + set escrow flag on AC-9937 in billing console; draft short email for Ana with exactly what to sign.

– Ben
